name: tie
description: ThisIsEnough — autonomous file-first workflow runtime. Run one skill, the orchestrator drives planning, implementation, evaluation, and fix loops until project completion or a real blocker.

interface.shortDescription: Run one skill. The orchestrator drives plan → implement → evaluate → fix loops until done or blocked.
interface.longDescription: ThisIsEnough is a file-first workflow runtime. The user states a requirement once; the orchestrator clarifies only when truly necessary, builds a roadmap, then for each phase autonomously runs Planner (rich product spec), Generator (implementation), and Evaluator (adaptive validation), looping fixes until the phase passes. State is isolated per run under agents_workspace/runs/<run-id>/, with agents_workspace/active_run pointing to the current/latest run so any session can resume cleanly. The doctor skill diagnoses, safely repairs, and migrates workflow state without starting workflow work.
defaultPrompt: Diagnose this workflow state with tie:doctor.
